basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support Posts
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Nagpur has invited applications for two posts, one Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) at 67000 + HRA (20% of basic) and one Project Technical Support III at 28000 + HRA (20% of basic), in the ICMR-funded research project "Strengthening ambulatory care for Non-Communicable Disease (STAR NCD)": An Implementation Research. The posts are for 06 months initially, with possible extension up to 30 March 2027. Applications are made through Google forms (one for each post) on or before 25 November 2026, 5 PM.

age_limit.details: SC/ST candidates: up to a maximum of 5 years. OBC candidates: up to a maximum of 3 years. Age relaxation up to 5 years may be granted to deserving candidates with experience of working in a Government Research Organization, on a case-to-case basis, by DG, ICMR/Head of the Institution.

how_to_apply: Choose the post. Use the Google form https://forms.gle/wRTJ4zNEEPy65mwV8 for Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical).
For Project Technical Support III, use the Google form https://forms.gle/pjjD3hub1LFNswps8.

Fill the application in the prescribed format (Annexure). The Annexure application form asks for the candidate's name, parents' names, local guardian and contact number, address for correspondence, mobile number, email id, date of birth, marital status, educational qualification, work experience, the joining time required, and whether the candidate has been declared unfit by a medical board or court for appointment in any Govt service.
Fill and sign the CV in the Annexure format, scan it and upload it in the designated place in the Google form only.
Submit on or before 25 November 2026, 5 PM. Applications received after the deadline will not be accepted or entertained.
For queries, the notice gives the email id [email protected].
important_instructions: Applications are accepted only in the prescribed format (Annexure). Candidates are cautioned against uploading generalized CVs. All notifications on this recruitment (eligibility list, interview date, venue, final results, addendum, corrigendum) will be published on the AIIMS Nagpur website only. No personal communication will be made to applicants. Canvassing of any kind will lead to summary rejection of the application.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Nagpur
content_sections.text: AIIMS Nagpur (Hindi name: Akhil Bharatiya Ayurvigyan Sansthan Nagpur) is the All India Institute of Medical Sciences at Plot no.2, Sector-20, MIHAN, Nagpur - 441108. The posts sit in an ICMR-funded implementation research project under Dr. S. Kalaiselvi (PI) and Dr. Sujiv Akkilagunta (Co-PI).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 2 vacancies in total. It does not print a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice says these are minimum qualifications and that candidates with higher qualifications can also apply. The age limit is 40 years for Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) and 35 years for Project Technical Support III. The notice does not print a date for counting age. SC/ST candidates: up to a maximum of 5 years. OBC candidates: up to a maximum of 3 years. Age relaxation up to 5 years may be granted to deserving candidates with experience of working in a Government Research Organization, on a case-to-case basis, by DG, ICMR/Head of the Institution. The candidate should be able to talk fluently in English, Marathi and Hindi. Candidates should also be willing to travel to rural and urban areas within Nagpur district. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees, with three years post qualification experience, or MPH/PhD.

Three years graduate in relevant subject/field (Medical Social work (Community development/Social Welfare/Medical) or (Sociology/psychology/life sciences + three years' experience (in the field-based research) or PG degree in relevant subject/field (Medical social work/anthropology).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary is consolidated per month and includes HRA and travel claims. Apart from this, the candidate is not admissible for any other allowances. The first appointment is for 06 months, and the total duration may be extended up to the project end date (30 March 2027), depending on project requirement and performance. The contract will be renewed based on performance evaluation by the project investigator, with the approval of the Director. A candidate who is not performing well can be terminated with a notice of one week. A candidate who wishes to resign must give 30 days' notice. Once the project duration is completed, the tenure is automatically over. These are tenure posts for a fixed duration under an ICMR-funded project, not regular posts under ICMR or AIIMS Nagpur. The selected candidate cannot claim permanent employment from either.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Choose the post. Use the Google form https://forms.gle/wRTJ4zNEEPy65mwV8 for Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical). For Project Technical Support III, use the Google form https://forms.gle/pjjD3hub1LFNswps8 . Fill the application in the prescribed format (Annexure). The Annexure application form asks for the candidate's name, parents' names, local guardian and contact number, address for correspondence, mobile number, email id, date of birth, marital status, educational qualification, work experience, the joining time required, and whether the candidate has been declared unfit by a medical board or court for appointment in any Govt service. Fill and sign the CV in the Annexure format, scan it and upload it in the designated place in the Google form only. Submit on or before 25 November 2026, 5 PM. Applications received after the deadline will not be accepted or entertained. For queries, the notice gives the email id [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Candidates may be shortlisted based on additional qualifications or work experience. In case of a high volume of applications, a written test may be conducted. A written test/skill test may also be held before the interview for further shortlisting, depending on the number of applications received and those appearing on the date of interview. Online interview will not be permitted. The date and venue of the interview will be communicated within 2-3 weeks following the application deadline. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only in the prescribed format (Annexure). Candidates are cautioned against uploading generalized CVs. All notifications on this recruitment (eligibility list, interview date, venue, final results, addendum, corrigendum) will be published on the AIIMS Nagpur website only. No personal communication will be made to applicants. Canvassing of any kind will lead to summary rejection of the application.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) and one Project Technical Support III.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 November 2026, till 5 PM, through the Google form for the post. Late applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees, with three years post qualification experience, or MPH/PhD.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years for Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) and 35 years for Project Technical Support III. SC/ST get up to 5 years' relaxation and OBC up to 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) gets 67000 + HRA (20% of basic); Project Technical Support III gets 28000 + HRA (20% of basic).

faq.question: Q6. Are allowances paid on top of the salary?
faq.answer: No. The salary is consolidated and includes HRA and travel claims, and the candidate is not admissible for any other allowances.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the AIIMS Nagpur project posts?
faq.answer: Fill the Google form for your post and upload the signed, scanned CV in the Annexure format in the designated place in that form.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview. A written test or skill test may be held, depending on the number of applications, and online interview is not permitted.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. These are fixed-duration tenure posts under an ICMR-funded project, 06 months initially, extendable up to 30 March 2027. They are not regular posts under ICMR or AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA given for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.
